where.zh: 野外與未設專屬曲風的地點（戰神台、漁村、悅來客棧、斷橋、古戰場、雲霧茶園、梅林、黑風洞）
where.en: The open country and places without their own mood (War God's Platform, Fishing Village, Yuelai Inn, Broken Bridge, Old Battlefield, Tea Terraces, Plum Grove, Black Wind Cave)

where.zh: 敵人追擊、與蕭／蒙面人交手或頭目戰時（加上鼓聲與快速琴音）
where.en: When foes give chase, when fighting Xiao or the masked man, or in a boss fight (frame drum and fast runs)

harness.notes: js/music.js is an ES module that imports ./sound.js; it only plays once sound.js's wake() has created the AudioContext (tick() returns while audio().ac is null). wake() is not re-exported by music.js, so init imports the SAME module URL (/wulin-world/js/sound.js, which ./sound.js resolves to) and calls wake(), then music.start() (setInterval 200 ms, 0.6 s look-ahead). init returns a Promise: the renderer must await it before play/render. If init is not awaited, put the same code in play.

notes: Generative music: Karplus-Strong guzheng random-walking a pentatonic scale (Math.random), no fixed loop; loopSec null, renderSec 75. Each region mood only changes root/tempo/density (game.js: music.mood(rg?.id || 'open') on region change; music.fight(...) every frame). The fight track uses the current region's root; here rendered over 'open'. music.js and sound.js are byte-identical to BrickBuilders'. Ambience noise (sound.js) is not started.
